name: Harry Rhodes
life: “I still remember standing on my own to fetch my first full pill box.” Thursday often includes a stop at the approach to Seabright Court, where Harry likes to watch the beach traffic thin enough for workers going the other way.
voice: I can reach my own medicine from a lower shelf. I wanted to tell the old worker before she stopped seeing me.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an old plum windbreaker and a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial. Harry has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side, with two white streaks in otherwise dark hair. Harry draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first during a conversation.
personality: Harry tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Harry will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To lower the medicine shelf and fetch it personally.
family: Terry Aranda is Harry’s younger cousin. When an older relative began losing nouns, they drew a map of places where familiar words came back. The map still gets folded correctly every time it comes out. Harry marks the places where asking a question helped. Asked about *The almost scholarship*, Terry says, “My own scholarship fell apart over an unpaid deposit.”
connections: Yvette Weber. A private introduction lets a client ask both for a particular knock and for medicine on a reachable shelf.

reactions.situation: The successor asks for a private introduction at the door
reactions.response: Harry introduces the successor quietly and gives the client a chance to set the routine.

reactions.situation: A neighbor offers to pay for a favor that was meant kindly
reactions.response: Harry suggests breakfast together and lets the offer rest until another day.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Harry repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
